data.disjointness: Check unique full documents and cross-split disjointness; finite substrings may repeat.
data.generator: same modular accumulator algorithm, fresh PRNG streams; actual generated bytes/hashes must be frozen before any training
data.teacher_forcing: Previous true readout values appear in future inputs; no answer-free full-document retention claim.

futility: Nonfinite values, failed identity/state checks, exhausted resource cap or preservation failure terminate as failed/incomplete. No posthoc shortened successful run. If learning check fails after full completion, report task nonlearning and do not promote geometry.
hypothesis: Under direct readout supervision, angular modulation improves state-readout prediction over an equal-count radial modulation control.
known_limits: Geometry controls match added parameter count, not Jacobian or FLOPs.
Native and nanoGPT differ in positional features, size and compute; their comparison is diagnostic.
Readout-only objective differs from prior all-token run; archived scores are not a matched paired loss ablation.

metrics.duplicates: Freeze all checkpoint hashes before reserved confirmation; compare repeated FP32 scores and logit hashes. No retuning from confirmation.
metrics.learning_check: Require rotation and radial each to reach at least 20% 8-choice readout accuracy on every seed before interpreting a geometry ranking; chance is 12.5%.
metrics.primary: Confirmation full-vocabulary CE on readout positions, nats/target
metrics.success_rule: All three rotation-radial CE gaps < 0, mean <= -0.02, descriptive paired-t 95% interval upper bound < 0, rotation beats native on every seed, and learning checks pass.
metrics.uncertainty: All seed rows and paired gaps; n=3 interval descriptive with unverified normality. Shared task holdout is not an independent dataset per seed.

primary_comparator: rotation versus radial; native and pinned nanoGPT are task-learning diagnostics
runtime_estimate: Unmeasured on this host. The prior archived 80-update experiment reports 7.874 CPU seconds on a different macOS runtime; not a host-specific estimate.
scope: synthetic task only; not language, long-context retention, speed, total memory, novelty or SOTA

training.checkpoint: Final update only, no best-checkpoint selection
training.objective: Mean full-vocabulary CE at fixed readout target positions 7,15,23,31 only; do not feed labels/masks as model input.
training.state: Carry across adjacent 16-token chunks without detach inside 32-token documents; reset at every document and split.

unresolved_before_execution: User exception for hosted workspace or access to the mandated mounted SSD.
Writable repository fork/branch for preregistration and PR.
Create fresh runner from prior immutable source; freeze its source and data hashes.
Fill full PROTOCOL_TEMPLATE and register exact run before launch.
Record actual runtime and executable permissions without changing sealed evidence.
